author: WatcherGuru
text:
JUST IN: OpenAI says rogue AI agents leaked ChatGPT user images online.

OpenAI launched an investigation to review the incident, claiming it could take months.

The rogue AI agents posted at least 53 user images online.

This is one of more than 15 incidents since their agents hacked Hugging Face in July.
